name: Beer Minute
description: A beer glass that fills over one minute, the level following the seconds: thick foam head, rising bubbles, the time in beer-gold.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Main'; return 1
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 1
